thread:
eli: quick sync - noticed increased warmup tail on prod for models with 4MB shards when CDN churn happens. sometimes checksum mismatch on a 64KB range causes full-shard re-fetch.
marie: are we validating per-range or only per-shard? I thought we had optional range-checks for streaming.
dan: current on-stream verifier computes per-shard sha256. if mismatch we fall back to whole shard. cheap to implement but bad for flaky networks.
priyaa: proposal: add range-level merkle in manifest so loader can prove and repair a single 64KB leaf instead of re-getting 200MB. server would expose `GET /shard/{id}/range?idx=` returning signed range.
eli: merkle sounds good but increases manifest size & compute. alternatives? small RS parity stripes per N ranges gives ECC-style repair.
marie: RS gives better resilience (recover lost ranges when multiple adjacent ranges fail) but adds encode/decode CPU. for hot paths, XOR parity is trivial and very fast. maybe support both: `parity_type: xor | rs` in manifest.
dan: loader changes: 1) stream into ephemeral range buffers; 2) verify leaf against merkle root or leaf-hash; 3) if mismatch -> request parity/repair endpoint; 4) apply repair and re-verify; 5) publish atomic range file and update index entry. avoid races with `range.inflight` marker.
priyaa: security: parity endpoints must accept the same auth tokens and return signed blobs. also audit parity metadata access in private deployments.
marie: metrics: `range_repair_requests`, `range_repair_success`, `range_repair_bytes`, and histogram `range_repair_latency_ms`. tag by model, region, transport.
eli: edgecases: what if repair fails repeatedly? fallback to whole-shard re-fetch after N attempts with exponential backoff. and cap total repair bytes to avoid DDOS-like amplification.
dan: plan: implement merkle + xor prototype, run chaosnet with 1% packet loss, measure warmup p95. feature flag `range_repair=true`. small RFC addendum next week.
ops-bot: rolling canary scheduled: build 2026.03.21-range-repair-canary-01, flag=eng-ml.range_repair@5pct.
priyaa: sweet. i'll add telemetry defs and security checklist. eli, dan: ping when POC ready.
